text:
I went there for a medical certificate required for the driving license extension, I got it in 45 minutes at a price of 150 bahts.
Go there in the morning before 11AM.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text:
If you want to have dental work done as a walk-in, you need to get a queue number starting at 6:00 AM, depending on the number of doctors available.
The other option is to make an appointment, but that will likely take about 2 months.
There is parking available.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: The last time I came, the service was lovely. This time, in the dental clinic, someone took my turn but didn't get the job done, yet they wouldn't open the queue for new people. The tone of voice was very harsh. The dentist was also heavy-handed, and they even messed up a filling I had previously had done, without apologizing.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text:
Today I came for my vaccination at a special half-day on Saturday. I was beyond impressed. The new location is convenient and clean. The signage is clear and beautiful. Parking is convenient.

The most impressive part was the service from the nurses who took my medical history. They were very friendly and always smiling. I was especially impressed when a grandmother's turn came in. When the nurse called my name, seeing that she was old, she said, "Don't get up, I'll go get her myself." She wanted to walk. I heard her anxious about the vaccine, so the nurse spoke comforting words to ease her worries. I really admire her. The service is better than many private clinics.

Also, the nurse who administered the vaccination was very nice. I commend her and encourage her to continue her good work.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: Today was my first time using the government's universal healthcare scheme for COVID-19 treatment. I was a little surprised, but this place was incredibly lovely. From the receptionist to the nurses who took my blood pressure and asked about my symptoms, and most importantly, the doctor who examined me and gave advice – it was even better than at a hospital! ❤️❤️❤️

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: Good service, everyone speaks well. On Monday, there weren't many people. There's parking under the building. First time coming, impressed.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: I went for an HIV test. The doctor was very kind and spoke nicely.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: Clean and tidy, easily accessible, and has parking. If you're lucky, you'll encounter helpful staff, but most of the time you'll be unlucky.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: I came for a teeth cleaning service. The staff were very polite, and the dentist was gentle; I didn't feel any pain. However, if you're using social security insurance, you'll need to pay upfront.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: I went to get my wound cleaned. I felt the place was clean and well-organized. There weren't many staff members, but they were dedicated to their work. The tone of voice and service were understandable; comparable to a private hospital, but with a more friendly atmosphere. There were long queues on some days.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: I came to inquire about having a difficult tooth extracted. I asked if an X-ray was needed beforehand and if I needed to stop taking blood thinners. When I asked the staff, they just sat behind a partition and talked amongst themselves instead of speaking into the designated area. The only answer I got was that I had to walk in on Monday morning because the schedule was full. It's as if you, as a dental assistant, can't even give me simple advice or answer my questions. They just said I needed to see a dentist first.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: Personally, I'm okay with it. The staff provided good service, were patient, and seemed willing to help. They didn't yell or scream at each other. I'll definitely use their services again when I have the chance.

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: I went to get medication for a COVID patient at 10:15 AM, but was told the queue was full. I asked if they could give me a list of medications or if I could see a doctor to describe the symptoms so I could buy the medicine, but they said no and wouldn't talk to me further (even the person selling drinks was more helpful). This is the worst service I've ever experienced. It's better to just go to a regular pharmacy and buy the medicine yourself.
author_name: บุญชิด เกษร

restaurant_name: ศูนย์บริการสาธารณสุข 51 จตุจักร
text: The staff provided good service. I went to pick up medication for my child. It had to be in the morning before 11:00 AM and the medication picked up in the afternoon at 2:00 PM, as per the center's operating procedures.
